user_prompt:
Last year there were 92 boys and 83 girls in Fairmont School. This year there are 210 students, and 97 are boys. How many more girls are there this year than last year? Show your work.

Answer: ____

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer:
This year there are 210 − 97 = 113 girls.
There are 113 − 83 = 30 more girls than last year.

Answer: 30
